name: Oshichi
source:
Died at the age of 16.

The heroine's best friend who works in the Human Realm as a model prisoner. Known as Yaoya Oshichi, and is searching for her lover from her past life.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/tengoku/characters/oshichi/]Aksys Games[/url]]
